name: source-v2
reason: Small source pilot fails on healthy/field examples; test a larger source cohort and limited feature fine-tuning.
exclude: All pilot-v1 recorded leaf groups; all UI sample/check-photo groups and exact hashes. No user-reported photos are training data.
source: Same pinned original PlantVillage release; record remaining limitations of capped directory listings.

training.augmentation: random resized crop, horizontal flip, rotation and moderate color jitter; evaluation remains deterministic square bilinear resize

selection: Candidate checkpoint selected only by source-v2 validation macro-F1. No threshold selection or training on field/test images.
evaluation: Source-v2 fresh grouped test; original field cohort can only be reused as a historical research benchmark, not a fresh blind test.
promotion: Do not silently replace live model. Document evidence and checks first. All management guidance remains disabled.
pre_training_amendment: Original capped source listings provided 391 additional valid groups rather than 880. Retain the original 250 TRAIN-ONLY images to form 641 total images, 475 train. All original non-training roles remain excluded. Amendment made after metadata audit and before fitting; no v2 predictions observed.
activation: Activated after training, ONNX parity, matched source-validation comparison and explicit user-facing disclosure; guidance remains disabled. Historical field results descriptive only.
